content: Two travelers shorten the longest and roughest road.
author: Celtic & Norse Proverbs
sourceWork: Giorraíonn beirt bóthar — Irish Gaelic Folk Adage
explanation: Trudging thirty miles through cold drizzle alone feels like an eternity of agonizing steps. But walk that identical stretch with a beloved friend or loyal companion—sharing tales, laughter, and silence—and the leagues vanish like mist. Companionship transforms endurance into joy.
practicalInsight: Invite a colleague or loved one to partner with you on a difficult task today. Make the road shorter.
reflectionPrompt: What grueling journey in your life have you been trying to walk alone instead of inviting a companion?
